# Update specs from changes and pull requests

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

The command is [`/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs`](reference/skills/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs.md).

## Two flows

A repo name from `docs/system/repos.md` may follow.

| You type | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs manual-flow` | Asks once before fetching, then you confirm the inventory, then each spec change is shown before it is written |
| `/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs manual-flow orders-api` | The same, for that one row |
| `/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs auto-flow` | Fetches without asking. Notes and `Synced at` are written. Spec changes stay a proposal list |
| `/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs auto-flow 30` | The same, with a 30 minute budget |
| `/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs` | Asks which flow. A headless run with no word stops and names the two words |

Both flows follow the same inventory and the same state machine, `scripts/sweep_progress.py --vendor copilot` in the skill. Do not edit `docs/system/sweep-progress.md` by hand.

It does not start `/crav1-add-to-spec` as a command.

## What it looks at

Every `docs/system/repos.md` row with a URL that is not `proposed`, except the specs repo.

For each repo in scope: unmerged branches with commits past `Synced at`, open pull requests including drafts, and pull requests that closed since the last sweep.

Left out: `main`, `master`, `develop`, `release/*`, and the row's `Merges into` branch. The sweep does not run `/crav1-review-pr` or `/crav1-pr-status`.

## Fetch

## Manual pace

Notes and `Synced at` do not each wait for a yes.

## Auto flow

**20 minutes** unless you passed another number. The run will not go past **45**. Quotes, new open questions, and `Answered:` lines stay on the proposal list.

## Where the place is saved

`docs/system/sweep-progress.md` in the specs repo lists this run's items and which are done.

`- Read: sweep | 7b41a0c, push 6, newest comment 2026-10-26T15:03Z | 2026-10-27`

`/crav1-pr-status` `since-last` still uses your own `Read` line.

`Synced at` stays the branch stamp.

## After

Then Run next, never a `Next:` line.

When items are still pending, `Next` is this same command, because the queue is not finished. When a conflict or an open question was written onto a spec, `Next` is `/crav1-resolve-open-questions` for those slugs. When the only leftover is proposals, `Next` is `/crav1-update-specs-from-changes-and-prs manual-flow`, because those spec changes are not written yet. Otherwise `Next` is `nothing needed now`.

A repo that was skipped is a `Waiting` line. When files changed: `Uncommitted: 2 files; commit with /crav1-finalize-commit when ready.` This command does not commit, and it does not run the next step.
